concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-001 (generate three distinct entropy variants) has no verified, completed task; T012 is marked completed but the required output files `data/processed/variants.csv` and `data/processed/generation_logs.json` are missing.
Functional Requirement FR-002 (compute Sequence Complexity Score) is not covered by any task; T014 is incomplete and the output `data/processed/complexity_scores.csv` does not exist.

Functional Requirement FR-003 (CPU‑optimized inference on ≥3 models) lacks a working pipeline; T021 (minimum‑model constraint) is missing its output `data/processed/inference_results.csv` and `code/inference/runner.py` is truncated.

Functional Requirement FR-004 (physics & consistency scoring) is uncovered; both T023 (baseline generator) and T024 (WBench suite) are incomplete and their expected artifacts (`baseline_scores.json`, `fidelity_metrics.csv`) are absent.
Functional Requirement FR-005 (Pearson correlation + ANOVA) is only partially satisfied: there is no task that computes the Pearson correlation coefficient, only ANOVA (T025/T027).
Success Criterion SC-001 requires a Pearson correlation coefficient and p‑value; no task produces these values, violating the spec.

Data‑model entity `DegradationCurve` is defined but no task creates or populates it; the pipeline only produces `analysis_summary.csv` (ANOVA results) and never a CSV matching the `DegradationCurve` schema.
Success Criterion SC-004 (measure total inference runtime against the 6‑hour limit) is not linked to any task or verification step; there is no task that records or asserts the overall runtime.

Success Criterion SC-002 (trend direction reporting) is only partially covered; while T025 computes a trend type, there is no explicit verification that the trend is reported in the final summary as required.
Success Criterion SC-003 (family‑wise error rate after Bonferroni) is not explicitly verified; T026 applies the correction but no task asserts that the corrected p‑values meet the α=0.05 threshold.
Success Criterion SC-005 (variance > 0.05) is only enforced by T016, but there is no downstream task that aborts the pipeline if the variance check fails, nor a test confirming the abort behavior.
Phase 1 task T001 (create top‑level directories) remains unchecked; without these directories the repository layout cannot be verified, breaking downstream tasks that assume their existence.
Phase 1 sub‑task T001a (create `tests/unit/`, `tests/integration/`, `tests/contract/`) is unchecked, preventing unit/integration verification of later code.
